title: Preparation of Primer TE Buffer (10mM Tris, 0.1mM EDTA, pH 8.0)
author: Jacquelina.Woods
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.byccpssw
materials: 100 µL Tris (1 M) pH 8.0 RNase-free Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #AM9856 ,, or equivalent.
20 µL EDTA (0.5 M) pH 8.0 RNase-free Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #AM9261 ,, or equivalent.
9.88 mL Nuclease-Free Water Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #AM9937 , or equivalent.

steps.title: Prepare Primer TE Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare a Primer TE Buffer consisting of 10mM Tris and 0.1mM EDTA at pH 8.0 by mixing the components together.

steps.title: Store Buffer
steps.instruction: Store the prepared buffer at room temperature.
